placements.why: The content describes a ratified architectural contract — the async dispatch model for remember — which is an architectural decision about system interaction and guarantees. No existing strata exists, so this category must be minted.
placements.title: Architectural contracts define system interaction surfaces
placements.theme: Architectural decisions establish how system components interact, what guarantees they provide, and how results are delivered.

placements.title: Remember becomes an async dispatch with receipt-based polling
placements.theme: Remember dispatches work asynchronously, returning a receipt in seconds while extraction proceeds under cursor-watched polling, with no blocking call and durability against dropped receipts.
placements.why: All three segments cohere under the async job contract for remember: the receipt-and-cursor shape (src-1), the non-blocking durability guarantees (src-2), and the dispatch-then-poll-or-piggyback delivery mechanism (src-3). This is a thematic subject future envelopes will keep feeding.
